question: What is the role of a transcription factor?

options.text: It joins RNA nucleotides together to form the mRNA strand during transcription
It binds to a specific mRNA sequence and increases or decreases the rate of translation
It binds to a specific DNA sequence and increases or decreases the rate of transcription
It breaks down mRNA molecules so that translation is stopped after a short time
